title: Inventory, own, and classify information assets: concept decisions 1
teachingQuestion: Who owns this asset, how should it be classified or categorized, and what handling decision follows?
focalInsight: Ownership and classification establish protection requirements only when tied to current inventory and enforceable handling.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Asset Inventory
nodes.definition: Authoritative record of information assets, systems, media, services, and dependencies.
nodes.detail: Authoritative record of information assets, systems, media, services, and dependencies.
nodes.decision: Record owner, custodian, location, type, purpose, classification, support state, and review trigger.
nodes.failureExample: An unregistered cloud store cannot be reliably protected or disposed.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Inventory makes the asset visible to decisions.

nodes.label: Data Owner
nodes.definition: Role accountable for value, classification, permitted use, and protection requirements.
nodes.detail: Role accountable for value, classification, permitted use, and protection requirements.
nodes.decision: Assign a business authority that can set handling and accept appropriate risk.
nodes.failureExample: A storage team decides a business record needs no retention.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Owner remains accountable even when work is delegated.

nodes.label: Data Custodian
nodes.definition: Role operating storage and safeguards for the owner.
nodes.detail: Role operating storage and safeguards for the owner.
nodes.decision: Give custody implementation duties and evidence without transferring owner decisions.
nodes.failureExample: Custodian changes classification without owner direction.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Custody operates controls on behalf of owner.

nodes.label: Classification
nodes.definition: Label or scheme result that drives protection and handling from sensitivity and impact.
nodes.detail: Label or scheme result that drives protection and handling from sensitivity and impact.
nodes.decision: Consider confidentiality, integrity, availability, privacy, law, criticality, aggregation, and owner context.
nodes.failureExample: A label is applied but access and disposal rules do not change.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Classification must enable a protection decision.

nodes.label: Sensitivity
nodes.definition: Degree of harm from unauthorized disclosure or misuse of information.
nodes.detail: Degree of harm from unauthorized disclosure or misuse of information.
nodes.decision: Assess content, subject, obligation, aggregation, and exposure consequence.
nodes.failureExample: Public fragments combine into a sensitive profile but remain low label.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Sensitivity can change through aggregation and context.

nodes.label: Criticality
nodes.definition: Importance of an asset or service to mission and required continuity.
nodes.detail: Importance of an asset or service to mission and required continuity.
nodes.decision: Assess disruption impact, time sensitivity, dependencies, and recovery need.
nodes.failureExample: Low-data-sensitivity dispatch service gets no availability plan.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Criticality drives availability and recovery decisions.

nodes.label: Categorization
nodes.definition: Grouping information with comparable sensitivity or protection obligations.
nodes.detail: Grouping information with comparable sensitivity or protection obligations.
nodes.decision: Use the governing framework and impact factors before assigning group.
nodes.failureExample: NIST categorization is assumed identical to every local classification label.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Know the scheme before interpreting a category.

nodes.label: Security Requirements
nodes.definition: Testable protection obligations derived from asset value and classification.
nodes.detail: Testable protection obligations derived from asset value and classification.
nodes.decision: Name property, control, owner, evidence, and review trigger.
nodes.failureExample: Classified record has no rule for sharing or retention.
